classification: Offline aggregation of explicitly allowlisted retained artifacts; no model requests. Mechanism, wire diagnostic, and Web gates are separate groups; missing completion audits remain pending.

metricDefinitions.completed: Execution completion, independent of strict instruction or answer quality; the original failed mechanism run remains failed.
metricDefinitions.overlap: Host stream lifecycle interval intersection only. Audits require serial foreground requests and at most one summary, avoiding double counting. Does not establish provider compute parallelism.
metricDefinitions.usage: Host/adapter-reported totalTokens, including cache token categories where reported. Cancelled streams may have null or zero usage; neither establishes free service. No billing amount inferred.
metricDefinitions.foregroundInstructionPassed: Brief: exact marker-only text. Standard: marker presence only, not full semantic validation of twelve requested checks.
metricDefinitions.retrieval: Whole-run durable tool results; success requires status=success. Attempts include denied or errored calls.
metricDefinitions.wire: One diagnostic pairs each fetch response to its own request and compares final foreground text; no claim that all host streams were mapped to wire IDs.
